messages:
Maya R: quick check — onboarding Harbor-13B weights to staging. I uploaded safetensors to s3://redwood-onboard/harbor-13b/v1/ but the conversion CI failed on shard 3. getting mismatched TP layout errors. cc @Jun K @Liam P
Jun K: on it, can you paste the conversion command + error snippet?
Maya R: used the usual tensorpack-convert v0.9: `tensorpack-convert --input s3://redwood-onboard/harbor-13b/v1 --output /tmp/harbor-v1 --format safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp-size 4 --shard-count 8`
Maya R: error in the logs:
```
ERROR: tensorpack: shard 3 mismatch: expected TP=2 layout but found TP=4
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/convert.py", line 212, in main
    reconcile_layout(cfg, shard_meta)
  File "/app/convert.py", line 98, in reconcile_layout
    raise ValueError("TP layout mismatch")
ValueError: TP layout mismatch
```
Liam P: that looks like a tensor-parallel layout mismatch. Serving runtime for Harbor is currently configured for TP=2 (we standardized small-mid models to TP=2 to avoid over-fragmentation). If the checkpoints were exported with TP=4 you'll need to convert or produce a TP=2-compatible shard layout.
Jun K: yep — two quick options: re-run conversion with `--tp-size 2` or run the re-sharder that collapses TP dims (slower). Which path did the exporter team take?
Maya R: exporter said they used a tooling default that picked TP=4. I can re-run conversion with `--tp-size 2`. Before I do — any caveats about kv cache ordering or tokenizer compatibility?
Sasha V: tokenizer quirk to note: Harbor's tokenizer (custom merges) sometimes produces a BOM-like "\uFEFF" token for names that start with special punctuation; our tokenization smoke caught 2 instances in the sample prompts. Not likely to break conversion, but we should record it in the packaging notes and include an extra tokenizer test.
Patrick G: also, make sure to place a metadata blob next to the weights: `metadata.json` with keys: `["tp_size","shard_count","dtype","tokenizer_version","tokenizer_notes"]`. Ops & infra tooling will read that for automatic route selection.
Opsbot: Reminder — use onboarding bucket pattern: `s3://redwood-weights/onboard/{team}/{model}/{version}`. Noncompliant uploads will be quarantined.
InfraBot: conversion job queued (job id 49382) by maya_r — will post status updates.
Jun K: when you re-run, run the quick-checker after convert: `python infra/tools/shm-checker.py --dir /tmp/harbor-v1 --expect-tp 2` — it verifies shard ordering + KV map.
Maya R: re-ran with `--tp-size 2` and added `--preserve-kv-order` flag. command: `tensorpack-convert --input s3://redwood-onboard/harbor-13b/v1 --output /tmp/harbor-v1 --format safetensors --dtype bf16 --tp-size 2 --shard-count 4 --preserve-kv-order`
Maya R: InfraBot reports job 49382 completed with exit code 0, but I still want someone to sanity-check checksums and tokenizer smoke. attaching shard checksums: sha256s: [shard0: a1b2..., shard1: c3d4..., shard2: e5f6..., shard3: 0a1b...]
Liam P: nice. can you run `./infra/tools/tokenizer-smoke.sh --model /tmp/harbor-v1 --samples samples/tokenizer-smoke.txt`? last time Harbor needed a small patch to merge rule 47 to avoid producing stray empty tokens.
Maya R: ran tokenizer smoke — 2 warnings about apostrophe-emoji sequences, but no empty tokens. I'll note it in metadata.
Jun K: I'll run shm-checker now and validate kv ordering. pinging when done.
Jun K: shm-checker output: all shards present, KV ordering preserved, tensor shapes match serving profiles, minor diff in shard2 checksum (recomputed, matches uploaded). passing.
Sasha V: I reviewed the tokenizer patch in the PR — LGTM. tests pass locally (1000 sample toks).
Patrick G: small ops note — please add an onboarding label in the manifest: `serve_ready: false` until we complete 24h smoke on staging, then flip to true.
Maya R: added metadata.json with fields and `serve_ready:false`. updated PR 402 with conversion command, metadata, and smoke logs. @Jun K @Sasha V can you PTAL?
Jun K: PTAL queued. will review quickly.
Sasha V: acked. LGTM.
Maya R: closing loop — marking board card as "awaiting 24h staging". thanks y'all :thumbsup:
